title: Registration Reporting and the Fleet Unit Incentive
content:
**Fleet incentive claim terms, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

How promptly a unit's registration was reported sets how the summed incentive is adjusted. The reporting record is the title application date on the deal, compared with the delivery date.

## Terms

1. **Filed more than 10 days after delivery.** For a unit whose title application date is more than 10 calendar days after its delivery date, the summed incentive is reduced by USD 25.00 for each day of that lag beyond 10 days.
2. **Not filed yet.** For a unit with no title application filed yet, the summed incentive is reduced by USD 25.00 for each calendar day from the delivery date to the handling date beyond 10 days.
3. **Floor on both reductions.** Neither reduction takes the incentive below 0.5 (one half) of the summed incentive.
4. **Filed within 10 days.** A unit whose title application was filed 10 calendar days or fewer after delivery keeps the summed incentive.

## Worked cases (hypothetical summed incentive of 1840.00; the floor is one half, 920.00)

| Reporting record | Days counted beyond 10 | Reduction | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Filed 10 days after delivery | none | none | 1840.00 |
| Filed 11 days after delivery | 1 | 25.00 | 1815.00 |
| Filed 27 days after delivery | 17 | 425.00 | 1415.00 |
| Filed 75 days after delivery | 65 | 1625.00, held to the floor | 920.00 |
| Not filed; handling date 8 days after delivery | none | none | 1840.00 |
| Not filed; handling date 23 days after delivery | 13 | 325.00 | 1515.00 |

## Points of judgement

- **Filed versus not filed.** Once a title application date is recorded, the lag is fixed by that date, and the handling date no longer matters. While no application is recorded, the count runs to the handling date.
- **The edge.** A lag of exactly 10 days keeps the whole summed incentive. A lag of 11 days loses 25.00.
